# The Problem: EntryCard Cannot Change App's State

#### Course: Build your First Web App with React

## The Problem: EntryCard Cannot Change App's State

You've had quite a long and (possibly) frustrating journey so far, but I hope the rewards have also been equally fulfilling. Thanks to your efforts, you can now finally add journal entries to your app.

But the list of entries lives inside App, and each EntryCard only receives title, date, content, and author from it.

If you add a "Delete" button on the card, the card has no way to remove that entry from the list. Only App can call setEntries() and change the list.

So the card must ask the parent (i.e., App) to do it:

- You pass a function from App to EntryCard.
- When the user clicks Delete, the card calls that function.
- The function runs in App and updates state.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, let's start this lesson by writing a callback for deleting.
